claim: Paper-described configuration with documented assumptions; multiclass 27-class experiment; not a verified Table 4 reproduction.

_paper_settings_evidence.scaling_evidence: Section 5.2, printed p.10 / PDF p.14: 'min-max normalization applied to training data only'
_paper_settings_evidence.partition_evidence: Section 5.1, printed p.9 / PDF p.13: 'stratified 70%/15%/15% train/validation/test'
_paper_settings_evidence.optimizer_evidence: Section 5.1, printed p.9 / PDF p.13: 'Adam optimizer with learning rate 0.001 and weight decay 0.0001'
_paper_settings_evidence.epochs_evidence: Section 5.1, printed p.9 / PDF p.13: '25 epochs'
_paper_settings_evidence.batch_evidence: Section 5.1, printed p.9 / PDF p.13: 'batch size 512'
_paper_settings_evidence.pgd_section54_evidence: Section 5.4, printed p.11 / PDF p.15: 'PGD: epsilon=0.10, 7 steps, alpha=epsilon/4=0.025, random start; domain clipping to normalized feature bounds'
_paper_settings_evidence.pgd_section33_conflict: Section 3.3, printed p.6 / PDF p.10: states alpha=epsilon/K (would be 0.10/7=0.01429); this conflicts with Section 5.4 alpha=epsilon/4=0.025. Section 5.4 is the execution-specific description; Section 3.3 is the general formula presentation. We follow Section 5.4 as the primary attack configuration.
_paper_settings_evidence.pgd_primary_choice: Section 5.4: 7 steps, alpha=0.025, random start. Section 3.3 general formula alpha=epsilon/K is secondary. Choice is Section 5.4 before execution; not post-hoc result selection.
_paper_settings_evidence.mode_ambiguity: Table 4 has no mode label. Section 3.1 describes binary. Sections 8.5 and 9 mention multiclass as future work. Binary is the strongest textual reading; we use multiclass as assigned and document the ambiguity.
_paper_settings_evidence.sequence_construction_evidence: Section 5.3 describes length 10 + noise 0.01 explicitly for RNN. Transformer sequence construction not specified. We retain the upstream repeat-50 construction as assumption C.
_paper_settings_evidence.domain_clipping_evidence: Section 5.4: 'clipping to [0,1] after normalization' (normalized feature bounds). We apply per-feature [min_train, max_train] clipping after each PGD step as the paper-described behavior, in addition to the epsilon box. Feature values outside training range remain in [-inf,+inf] after min-max scaling; we note this interaction.
_paper_settings_evidence.checkpoint_rule_evidence: Not specified in paper. Assumption: final epoch 25 checkpoint, no validation-based selection.

_conflict_log.pgd_alpha: Section 5.4 gives alpha=epsilon/4=0.025 for 7 steps. Section 3.3 formula gives alpha=epsilon/K=0.10/7≈0.0143. These differ. We select Section 5.4 as the execution-specific description and document this choice before execution.
_conflict_log.mode: Binary is the dominant paper context. Table 4 mode unverified. We use multiclass as per assignment instructions.
_conflict_log.dataset_composition: Paper reports approximately 60% benign CICIoT2023 with 33 attack categories. Our CSV has 27 equal-sized classes. Compositions differ substantially; we use the available CSV and document the difference.
_conflict_log.seed_list: Paper mentions five seeds generally; Phase 2 lists {1,7,13,21,42}. Phase 1 (Table 4) seed list not established. We use {1,7,13,29} matching the artifact baseline for cross-experiment consistency.
_conflict_log.f1_definition: Table 4 F1 not labeled as macro or weighted. We compute and report both; neither is asserted to match Table 4.
_conflict_log.asr_definition: Paper ASR denominator not established. We use clean-correct denominator and also save prediction-change and all-row error rates separately.

seed_semantics.split: Single stratified 70/15/15 split using split_seed=2025; shared across all four training seeds
seed_semantics.split_seed_choice: Assumption C: predetermined before execution; not chosen to match any published result
seed_semantics.training: Python/numpy/torch seeded to training seed per run; our reproducibility addition
seed_semantics.sequence_noise: numpy.default_rng(training seed) for training sequences; evaluation is noise-free
seed_semantics.attacks: FGSM and PGD are deterministic given model/input; PGD random start uses torch.manual_seed(training_seed) before attack loop per batch

preprocessing.fit_evidence: A: explicitly stated in paper Section 5.2
preprocessing.transform_applied_to: training, validation and test using the same fitted scaler
preprocessing.numeric_cleaning: numeric coerce; missing and infinite values -> 0 (B: inherited from released data_loader)
preprocessing.label_encoder: alphabetically ordered LabelEncoder fitted on training labels only
preprocessing.missing_values: replaced with 0 before scaling (same as artifact baseline)
preprocessing.out_of_range_handling: MinMaxScaler can produce values outside [0,1] for validation/test features outside training range; this is expected and not clipped at preprocessing time. PGD domain clipping uses per-feature [min_train, max_train] bounds.
preprocessing.constant_features: features with zero variance in training are divided by 1 (sklearn MinMaxScaler default); no features are dropped

partition.method: first split off test_size=0.15/(1.0) -> test; then split remainder -> 0.15/(0.85) -> validation, 0.70/(0.85) -> train
partition.split_evidence: A: stratified 70/15/15 explicitly stated in paper Section 5.1/5.2
partition.duplicate_rows_note: Random row-level split; does not separate duplicate feature groups. Audit reports 18,044 repeated feature rows in the full CSV; overlap between partitions is measured and reported but not corrected.
partition.evaluation_population: full held-out test partition; not capped; distinct from released artifact's capped validation evaluation

architecture_notes: Unchanged upstream StandardTransformerIDS. Fixed sinusoidal PE; post-norm residual blocks; ReLU FFN; mean pooling; MLP 96->48->27 logits. Upstream unused 96->64->1 anomaly scorer retained; CE only. 351612 parameters. Architecture evidence: A (Section 5.3 / Table 3).

sequence.training: repeat each single scaled row 50 times; independent Gaussian std=0.01 at each time step
sequence.evaluation: repeat single scaled row 50 times; no noise
sequence.evidence: C: assumption — Section 5.3 describes length 10 + noise 0.01 for RNN; Transformer sequence construction not specified. We retain the upstream repeat-50 construction as the closest available approximation.

training.checkpoint_rule: final epoch 25, no validation/evaluation-based selection (assumption C)
training.checkpoint_rule_evidence: C: paper does not specify final-vs-best validation rule; we use final epoch and declare this before execution
training.optimizer_type_evidence: A: Section 5.1 'Adam optimizer' — we use AdamW to implement weight decay correctly; plain Adam with weight_decay=0.0001 applies L2 regularization to gradients which is mathematically equivalent for Adam but not the decoupled form. We use AdamW (decoupled weight decay) as the more principled interpretation.

evaluation.population: full held-out test partition; 4500 rows per seed (shared split, same test rows across seeds); same row IDs across conditions

fgsm.domain_clipping_bounds: per-feature [min_train, max_train] in normalized (MinMaxScaler) space; clipped after the single gradient step
fgsm.domain_clipping_evidence: A: Section 5.4 describes clipping to normalized feature bounds

pgd.initialization: random start: x + uniform(-epsilon, epsilon) per element, then projected to epsilon box; torch seeded with training seed before attack
pgd.projection: elementwise [x-epsilon, x+epsilon] AND per-feature [min_train, max_train] domain clipping after each step
pgd.evidence: A: Section 5.4 — epsilon=0.10, 7 steps, alpha=epsilon/4=0.025, random start, domain clipping
pgd.conflict_note: Section 3.3 general formula gives alpha=epsilon/K=0.10/7≈0.0143; Section 5.4 execution description gives alpha=epsilon/4=0.025. We follow Section 5.4.

metrics.macro_f1: unweighted mean of 27 per-class F1 values, zero_division=0
metrics.per_class: precision, recall, F1, support for all 27 labels
metrics.std: sample standard deviation ddof=1 over completed seeds; n<2 -> unavailable
metrics.paper_f1_note: Table 4 F1 averaging not established; we report both macro and weighted; neither is asserted to match Table 4
metrics.paper_asr_note: Table 4 ASR denominator not established; our ASR uses clean-correct denominator

A_explicitly_paper: MinMaxScaler fitted on training data only (Section 5.2)
PGD epsilon=0.10, 7 steps, alpha=0.025, random start, domain clipping (Section 5.4)
B_inherited_from_released_code: Sequence repeat-50 construction (upstream _expand_to_sequence, length modified to match paper Section 5.3 spirit)
Gaussian noise std=0.01 for training sequences
C_assumption: Multiclass mode (assignment requirement; Table 4 mode unverified)
Seeds {1,7,13,29} (Phase 1 seed list not established; chosen for cross-experiment consistency)
Final epoch checkpoint, no validation-based selection
Sequence length 50 (paper describes length 10 for RNN; Transformer not specified)
AdamW vs plain Adam with L2 (paper says 'Adam with weight decay'; AdamW is the decoupled interpretation)
PGD random seed tied to training seed per batch

paper_table4_correspondence: unresolved; several conditions for establishing exact correspondence remain unmet (see docs/MILESTONE1_REFERENCE.md). This experiment uses paper-described settings where available, plus documented assumptions.
